name: FarmOS (Legacy)
tagline: A web-based farm record keeping application.
description: farmOS is a web-based application for farm management, planning, and record keeping. It is developed by a community of volunteers and aims to provide a standard platform for farmers, developers, and researchers to build upon.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Mysql root password
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
# Service definitions for the big-bear-farmos application
services:
  # Service name: big-bear-farmos
  # The `big-bear-farmos` service definition
  big-bear-farmos:
    # Name of the container
    container_name: big-bear-farmos
    # Image to be used for the container
    image: farmos/farmos:3.5.9@sha256:2f97cb523c800917ca81e5726142c9ed6de9d46ff550094afb69074e9297f2d0
    # Container restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped
    # Volumes to be mounted to the container
    volumes:
      # Mounting the local homarr/configs directory to /app/data/configs inside the container
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/sites:/opt/drupal/web/sites
    # Ports mapping between host and container
    ports:
      # Mapping port 8080 of the host to port 80 of the container
      - "${APP_PORT}:80"
    networks:
      - big-bear-farmos-network
  # MariaDB database service configuration for FarmOS
  big-bear-farmos-db:
    # Specify the container name
    container_name: big-bear-farmos-db
    # Use MariaDB version 10 image
    image: mariadb:10@sha256:be981e4113326ada8d6004174dd09eeaefc03094037f811182a52d4f2e737350
    # Mount the database files to persist data
    volumes:
      - "${APP_DATA_DIR}/db:/var/lib/mysql"
    # Expose MariaDB port to host
    ports:
      - "3306:3306"
    # Database environment configuration
    environment:
      # Root user password
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD}
      # Name of the database to create
      MYSQL_DATABASE: big_bear_farmos
      # Create a database user
      MYSQL_USER: farmos
      # Set the database user password
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD}
    # Health check configuration to ensure database is running properly
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "healthcheck.sh", "--connect", "--innodb_initialized"]
      start_period: 1m
      start_interval: 10s
      interval: 1m
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
    # Connect to the FarmOS network
    networks:
      - big-bear-farmos-network
networks:
  big-bear-farmos-network:
    name: big-bear-farmos-network
    driver: bridge
